# Computational Matter Zoo

Discover a robust, controllable repertoire of physical computations; preserve selective coupling and protected decoupling as competing design directions.

Source: https://app.notion.com/p/3f96336816258179a894fa15a2eef695?pvs=204

All 27 source sections are preserved. Experiment plans and extension contracts are proposals; no simulations were run.

## Expansion contracts

### Z01: Freeze model and benchmark contract (Build)

Executable E01 model; named units/boundary/ports; residual, conditioning and size checks.

Declare which proposed measurements are inapplicable. No topology, memory or validation claim from a static spectrum.

Dependencies: none

### Z02: Challenge benchmark assumptions before execution (Challenge)

Independent specification audit; alternative explanations; revised acceptance gates.

Distinguish mode diversity from port-accessible response and reject implicit cross-family equivalence.

Dependencies: none

### Z03: Propose paired defect interventions (Explore)

E02 candidate pairs with fixed perturbation cost and matched random controls.

Produce design files and falsifiable predictions; no unrun metrics.

Dependencies: Z01, Z02

### Z04: Measure accessible response and equal-budget baselines (Evaluate)

E01/E03 calculations and loss/port/size sensitivity records.

Freeze ports, quality gates, seeds, compute budget and descriptor versions before comparisons.

Dependencies: Z01, Z02

### Z05: Audit descriptors and proposed schema changes (Challenge)

DescriptorProposal or rejection, with counterexample and migration requirements.

New axes require independent tests; never promote from novelty rhetoric.

Dependencies: Z03, Z04

### Z06: Synthesize mechanisms and plan fidelity escalation (Synthesize)

Competing mechanism map, unresolved evidence needs and one higher-fidelity protocol.

Keep failed/null results, family limits and human decision separate from simulation success.

Dependencies: Z05

## Boundaries

- This is a faithful source import plus explicitly proposed implementation contracts. It contains no new physics results.
- The graph is a proposed scientific schema, not a category with proved composition laws or a verified functor.
- Local-view restriction is literal field projection; matching metadata does not certify a scientific translation.
- Specialty labels do not establish orthogonal reasoning; require method/evidence/assumption declarations and disclose shared models, tools and data.
- The static explorer prepares packets and downloads; Agent Commons coordinates durable tasks. It does not launch runtimes.
- C in the source denotes damping and readout in different equations; the mechanical template uses D for damping and C_out for readout.
